pg006_n0004: This Arts and Sports book has been specifically written for Standard Three Pupils in mainland Tanzania.
pg006_n0005: This book has been prepared according to the Arts and Sports syllabus issued by the Ministry of Education, Science and Technology in 2023.
pg006_n0006: Some of the themes in this book have been taken from the previous books on Sport and Art Standard One and Vocational Skills Standard Five published in 2019 in accordance with the 2016 syllabi.
pg006_n0008: This book has eight chapters, which are Acting, Singing, Musical instruments, Drawing, Clay modelling, Physical exercise, Traditional games and Participating in art exhibitions and sports competitions.
pg006_n0009: By learning its contents, you will master the basics of singing and acting, drawing pictures and modelling various shapes.
pg006_n0010: You will also manage physical exercise, play traditional games and participate in works of art and sports.
pg006_n0012: The contents of these chapters are presented in the form of text, activities, pictures, and exercises.
pg006_n0013: Therefore, perform all the tasks in this book and other tasks the teacher gives to you.
pg006_n0014: This will enable the development of knowledge and skills intended for you.

pg007_n0007: Performing arts involve acting, storytelling, riddles, dance, dramatic poetry, comic skits, recitations, children’s plays, and rituals.
pg007_n0008: In this chapter, you will learn one type of performing arts known as acting.
pg007_n0009: You will also learn how to act and imitate various sounds of living and non-living things.

pg007_n0023: Acting is the skill of imitating something.
pg007_n0024: It represents the reality of a person’s daily life in his or her environment.
pg008_n0002: Acting takes place before an audience to convey the intended message.
pg008_n0003: The performance that takes place during acting is called play.
pg008_n0004: Some types of play use words and actions; others do not use words; and yet others involve dance drama.
pg008_n0005: A play can end happily or sadly.
pg008_n0006: An actor employs body movements, facial expressions, voice, the environment and imagination.
pg008_n0007: This is meant to show the reality of what is being acted.
pg008_n0008: Acting involves four essentials, as follows:
pg008_n0012: A performer, who is called an actor;
pg008_n0015: A message, which is called a theme;
pg008_n0018: A performing place, known as the stage; and
pg008_n0021: People who watch the performance, known as the audience.

pg018_n0004: Singing is a production of musical sounds using voice.
pg018_n0005: Different types of songs are sung in our environment.
pg018_n0006: Examples are traditional dance songs, choir, dance music, bongo fleva, singeli and taarabu.
pg018_n0010: Proper posture during singing is the correct way the singer positions himself or herself.
pg018_n0011: The singer can sing while standing straight, sitting or dancing.
pg018_n0012: Proper posture positions the body correctly for easy breathing.
pg018_n0013: During singing, the singer should position parts of the body correctly, as follows:
pg018_n0017: The neck should be straight, without rising or bending;
pg018_n0020: The shoulders and arms should be relaxed;
pg018_n0023: The chest and stomach should not be tight; and
pg018_n0026: The legs should be spread, without being brought closer together.

pg020_n0004: Proper breathing helps a singer to sing without cutting off words.
pg020_n0005: Thus, the singer can deliver the message correctly.
pg020_n0006: To breathe properly, the singer should do breathing exercises.
pg020_n0007: An example is breathing in and out slowly.
pg020_n0008: This exercise enables the singer to inhale during singing.
pg020_n0009: When the singer inhales properly, he or she can sing without cutting off words.
pg020_n0010: For example, in a song like Mungu Ibariki Afrika, the singer should not pause before finishing all the words in the first sentence.
pg020_n0020: Breathe in slowly through your nose for three seconds;
pg020_n0023: Hold your breath for three seconds; then,
pg020_n0026: Release your breath slowly through your nose for three more seconds.
pg020_n0030: Then, sing the first verse of the National Anthem, Mungu Ibariki Afrika.

pg025_n0004: Musical instruments are tools used to produce musical sounds.
pg025_n0005: Each type of musical instruments has its unique sound that makes the music interesting.
pg025_n0006: It also has a taste and arouses various feelings.
pg025_n0007: These instruments can add goodness to music by giving out rhyming sounds to accompany the voices of singers or sounds of other musical instruments.
pg025_n0011: Musical instruments are divided into different groups.
pg025_n0012: These groups include wind instruments, struck instruments, stringed instruments and percussion instruments.
pg025_n0013: These different types of instruments can be found in different societies in the world.

pg043_n0031: Before modelling, prepare clay soil in the following ways.
pg043_n0034: 1. Pound the clay soil until it gets soft.
pg044_n0003: 2. Sieve it to remove unwanted materials, such as sand particles and leaves.
pg044_n0005: 3. Mix clay soil with water and knead it to get a soft clay lump.
pg044_n0007: 4. Choose an object to make and start modelling.
pg044_n0009: Steps to be followed in modelling by pinching
pg044_n0012: 1. Choose the object you want to model.
pg044_n0016: 3. Knead the clay soil to remove air.
pg044_n0018: 4. Create a clay ball between your hands.
pg044_n0020: 5. Press your thumb in the ball.
pg044_n0022: 6. Enlarge the hole by pinching while turning the ball around.
pg044_n0024: 7. Continue pinching and moving the ball around.
pg044_n0025: Ensure the wall of the object always has the same thickness.
pg044_n0027: 8. Complete the object by adding a handle or sprout.
pg044_n0029: 9. Place the object in the shade for a short time to dry slightly.
pg044_n0031: 10. Put decorations, such as colour, before the object is completely dry.
pg044_n0033: 11. Place it in the shade again until it is completely dry.

pg057_n0007: Traditional games can develop children’s culture in society.
pg057_n0008: There are many types of traditional games.

pg058_n0004: Traditional games are those that have been played for a long time in society.
pg058_n0005: Examples of traditional games are rede, running with a bottle balanced on the head, bao and running with an egg on a spoon.
pg058_n0009: Rede is a ball game played using hands.
pg058_n0010: It is played by both boys and girls.
pg058_n0011: The ball should be small and light.

pg058_n0017: 2. Rede by filling a bottle with sand.

pg067_n0008: In the preceding chapters, you learnt about acting, singing, drawing and clay modelling.
pg067_n0009: You also learnt about physical exercise and traditional sports.
pg067_n0010: In this chapter, you will learn how to prepare and participate in sports competitions and art exhibitions at class level.
pg067_n0011: The skills developed will enable you to participate in various art exhibitions and sports competitions at school and in the community.
pg067_n0017: (c) Things to consider during art exhibitions and sports competitions
pg068_n0004: Art exhibitions and sports competitions are good ways to develop talent, creativity and self-confidence among pupils.
pg068_n0005: In this chapter, you will participate in showing your various artworks as well as participate in sports competitions at class level.
pg068_n0006: The art exhibitions will include acting, singing, drawing and clay modelling.
pg068_n0007: The sports competitions will include physical exercise and traditional games.

pg068_n0015: Choose a topic for the performance.
pg068_n0016: Choose a message that describes life in your community.

pg068_n0020: Join a group with your fellows for preparation;
pg068_n0023: Prepare an advertisement and the timetable for the performance.
pg068_n0024: Make sure that it includes the time for preparation, practice and the show itself;
pg068_n0027: Practise the performance based on the instructions from the teacher.
pg068_n0028: Make sure that you practise enough to give a good performance;

pg069_n0011: This activity should be done under the guidance of your teacher;
pg069_n0014: After the show, make sure the area used for the performance is clean, and all the equipment used is removed; and
pg069_n0017: Evaluate the success or limits of the performance to improve future performances.

pg072_n0017: Singing shows are events where singers can show their singing skills in front of an audience.
pg072_n0018: They take place on special platforms or locations such as schools, concert halls or art galleries.
pg072_n0019: Children or adults can join these shows.
pg072_n0020: In these shows, singers go on stage and sing different songs for educating, entertaining and sending a certain message to the audience.
pg072_n0021: Singing shows can involve singing competitions or concerts aimed at providing entertainment.
pg072_n0022: Singers can sing their own songs or special pre-arranged songs.

pg073_n0010_easy_read: Choose a song for the show.
pg073_n0011_easy_read: It is good to choose a song you like.
pg073_n0012_easy_read: The song should also have an attractive message.
pg073_n0013_easy_read: The song should connect with people in the community.
pg073_n0017_easy_read: Practice should include vocal exercises and singing.
pg073_n0018_easy_read: If you will sing the song as a group, practise the song with the other group members.
pg073_n0019_easy_read: Good preparation makes the singer confident.
pg074_n0002_easy_read: So the person can perform well in front of the audience;
pg074_n0007_easy_read: Before the show, check the venue or platform that you will use.
pg074_n0008_easy_read: Do a short test of how you will sing on the day of the show.
pg074_n0009_easy_read:
This test includes:
- getting to know the stage
- testing how the musical instruments work
pg074_n0013_easy_read: On the day of the show, leave enough time to rest before the show.
pg074_n0014_easy_read: Arrive early at the venue where the show will be held; and
pg074_n0018_easy_read: During the performance, show your feelings about the song with confidence so you send the message you want.
pg074_n0019_easy_read: If it is a happy song, smile and show that you are happy.
pg074_n0020_easy_read: If it is a sad song, show those feelings with your voice or actions.
